parsed.explanation: Worst features are tier-1 state-imposed universal exposures: the 2025 ruling plus the in-force single-sex spaces code exclude trans people from services by biological sex; trans hospital patients face ward exclusion (a documented death followed removal); custody and strip-search practice follows birth sex. These reach every outed traveller and lack a shown working remedy (challenge at pre-action only), placing it per rule 21 in Elevated Risk. Mitigating: no criminalisation of trans identity, gender-reassignment discrimination protection retained, functioning rule of law, no documented violence or police targeting of trans visitors, large LGBT communities. Custody/detention probability for a visitor is low, but the ward and facility exclusions are continuous. Net: above High Risk, below Reduced Risk.
